② Back: thinner pillow, rolled towel in the case
③ Tummy: head twisted for hours, go very flat

slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice
items: Pain after a fall or crash

caption:
Koko has a drawer full of pillows and her neck is still stiff every morning. There's no magic pillow. What matters is keeping the head roughly in line with the spine, so the pillow height should fill the gap between your head and the mattress.

Side sleepers usually need a firmer, higher pillow to fill the space above the shoulder, and hugging a pillow in front stops you rolling forward. Back sleepers often do better with a thinner pillow, maybe a rolled towel inside the case. Tummy sleeping twists the neck for hours, so go very flat or slowly train yourself onto your side.

Arm tingling or weakness, dizziness, severe headaches or pain after a fall should be checked promptly. Book online via the link in bio 🐨

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
